ai-platform-226: What is a franchise AI platform?
ai-platform-227: It's an AI system built for franchises that analyzes sales, order, inventory, franchise sales, and operations data together to forecast demand and risk and recommend next tasks. FDAM is an AI operations platform for franchises that builds this AI into both the HQ ERP and Sodam, the store app, so predictions lead straight into ordering, inspection, and reporting work.
ai-platform-228: How is FDAM AI different from general AI tools?
ai-platform-229: General-purpose AI tools answer questions. FDAM AI directly reads the POS and delivery app sales, order, inventory, and HQ operations data connected to FDAM, and alerts you first when something changes. Results are acted on right inside FDAM, as order approvals in Sodam, supervisor inspection tasks, and operations reports.
ai-platform-230: Do we need to replace our existing POS or ERP?
ai-platform-231: Not necessarily. FDAM first looks at connecting your existing POS and ERP. After reviewing how your current systems can integrate and what data is available, we design the right approach, such as API integration or file-based collection.
ai-platform-232: How is AI order recommendation accuracy verified?
ai-platform-233: We compare FDAM AI's recommended order quantities against actual sales and inventory outcomes. Because accuracy varies by store, item, training period, and data quality, we keep checking the same way after rollout. Our in-house lab verified 90% recommendation accuracy on real customer data.
ai-platform-234: Does AI order recommendation place orders automatically?
ai-platform-235: By default, FDAM AI proposes a recommended order first, and the store owner reviews and approves it in Sodam. The actual level of automation is set to match your brand's policies.
ai-platform-236: Can we start without much data?
ai-platform-237: Yes. FDAM first assesses the time span and quality of the data you have, and you can start step by step with rule-based recommendations or a limited-scope model.
ai-platform-238: Are all AI features available right away?
ai-platform-239: Availability and requirements can differ by FDAM AI feature. During consultation, we clearly distinguish features that are available now, in beta, custom-built, or coming soon.
